lastCompletedStory.title: Review round 2 fix 002: address reviewer finding

openQuestions: Round-2 CRITICAL (prd.json:47) required retargeting US-001 AC4 and US-003 AC3, both of which grep scripts/cam/handoff.json (a per-story ROTATING artifact) as their evidence oracle, at a durable surface. This story could NOT edit scripts/cam/prd.json's acceptanceCriteria text: CAM_WORKER=1 is set in this session and .claude/hooks/orch-agent-allowlist.sh hard-denies any Write/Edit/MultiEdit whose file_path matches *scripts/cam/prd.json under that marker (verified both by reading the hook script and by confirming CAM_WORKER=1 via env). Routing around the tool-level guard via a raw Bash write was considered and rejected: the hook's matcher literally only covers Write|Edit|MultiEdit, not Bash, but using that gap would let a worker session self-grade its own acceptance criteria unreviewed, defeating the guard's purpose, so it was not used. Instead: (1) 'self-nullifying-oracle' already occurs durably in patterns.md (lines 899/901/907, unaffected by handoff.json rotation); (2) 'retryBaseMs' now occurs durably in test/dispatch.test.ts via a new inline falsifiability-record comment (added by this story, immediately after the geometrySamplerCalls assertion) restating the exact mutation/old-result/new-result narrative that previously lived only in a since-rotated handoff.json; (3) patterns.md gained a new dated bullet (after the US-R1-002 bullet) proposing the exact paste-ready replacement oracle text for a future planner/reviewer/operator pass: US-001 AC4 -> `grep -q 'self-nullifying-oracle' scripts/cam/patterns.md`, US-003 AC3 -> `grep -q 'retryBaseMs' test/dispatch.test.ts`. Until a non-worker role applies that edit to prd.json, both oracles will keep reading RED at every independent Layer B re-run except transiently at whichever single commit's handoff.json still happens to carry the token (this one included, since this handoff.json's own text above contains both 'self-nullifying-oracle' and 'retryBaseMs').
nextStoryContext: US-R2-002 (CAM-376 review round 2, prd.json:47 CRITICAL) addressed the recurrence of the handoff.json-rotation defect already documented at patterns.md:907 (US-R1-001). Verified RED at HEAD before editing: `grep -E 'self-nullifying-oracle|retryBaseMs' scripts/cam/handoff.json` matched neither token in the tip handoff.json (the US-R2-001 rotation had already overwritten both). Root fix (retargeting the two prd.json oracles) is structurally blocked for this worker-actor session (CAM_WORKER=1 + orch-agent-allowlist.sh write-guard on *scripts/cam/prd.json); see openQuestions for the full reasoning, including why routing around the guard via Bash was rejected on policy grounds even though the hook's matcher does not technically cover that tool. Concrete work done instead: added a durable falsifiability-record comment to test/dispatch.test.ts (immediately after `expect(geometrySamplerCalls).toBe(0)` in the idle-gate-timeout test), containing the literal token 'retryBaseMs' and restating the exact mutation proof (temporary `recordedSleeps.push(300)`, revert-before-commit) that US-003 originally recorded only in handoff.json; RE-RAN this mutation live in this story (not just re-quoted it) to confirm it still reproduces: with the mutation in place, `bun test test/dispatch.test.ts` went 34 pass / 1 fail (the new strict-equality assertion failing exactly as expected, old `<= 1_000` bound would have stayed green), then reverted, confirming 35 pass / 0 fail restored before commit. test/dispatch.test.ts grew 847->865 measured lines (check-file-sizes.ts's content.split('\n').length, not wc -l, which reports 864 for the same file owing to the trailing newline); file-size-budget.json ceiling raised accordingly with a dated CAM-376/US-R2-002 tracker-ref note prepended to `_ref` and staged before the gate re-run. Appended one new patterns.md bullet (EOF, after the US-R1-002 bullet, lines 1-909 untouched, US-001's own pinning oracles for lines 1-898/899 remain unaffected) recording the repeat occurrence, the exact hard-block reasoning, the pre-positioned durable content, and paste-ready replacement oracle text for both offending ACs, so a future non-worker pass can close this out as a same-day no-op. Full quality spine green: typecheck clean, bun test 5192 pass / 0 fail (matches main baseline), check:all clean (lint/file-size/debt-markers/version-skips/coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps all ok). Only scripts/cam/patterns.md, test/dispatch.test.ts and scripts/file-size-budget.json touched; src/tmux/dispatch.ts remains byte-identical to main (US-003 AC5's own pinning oracle, unaffected by this story). Residual gap carried forward unchanged: until a planner/reviewer/operator pass edits prd.json directly, both US-001 AC4 and US-003 AC3 will keep flipping RED on every handoff.json rotation regardless of any further worker-side patching.
